resources.string:
Having stock Shizuku installed alongside ShizukuX can cause permission conflicts and app crashes. To ensure ShizukuX functions correctly, please uninstall or disable the stock Shizuku app.

You can do this via:
1. Settings -> Apps -> Shizuku -> Disable/Uninstall
2. Below buttons (if ShizukuX service is running)
3. ADB: adb shell pm disable-user --user 0 moe.shizuku.privileged.api
Stock Shizuku has been disabled successfully.
Failed to disable Stock Shizuku. Ensure ShizukuX is running or use ADB manually.
